data.name: Coronado Ferry Tickets
data.headline: Purchase your Ferry tickets today! | All Ages
data.description:
Flagship Ferry is the most scenic way to cross San Diego Bay. Sail between downtown San Diego, the Coronado Ferry Landing, and the San Diego Convention Center while enjoying waterfront views, fresh bay breezes, and easy access to shopping, dining, and local attractions.

Coronado ferry tickets are valid for the purchased route and may be used on any scheduled departure, subject to vessel capacity. We recommend arriving at least 10 minutes prior to departure. During busy weekends, holidays, conferences, and special events, please allow extra time. Bicycles are welcome aboard at no additional charge, space permitting.

meeting_point.address: 990 North Harbor Drive, San Diego, CA

data.cancellation_summary: Reservations are non-refundable. Please provide Flagship with 24-hour notice prior to the cruise date to reschedule your cruise to another time and date.
data.booking_notes:
###Broadway Pier Schedule
Daily ferry service between Coronado Ferry Landing and Broadway Pier, located at 990 N. Harbor Drive in San Diego. Runs every hour.

***From Broadway Pier***

First departure: 9:00am
Departs every hour on the hour (9:00, 10:00, 11:00, etc.)
Last departure: 9:00pm (10:00pm on Friday & Saturday)

***From Coronado***

First departure: 9:30am
Departs every hour on the half-hour (9:30, 10:30, 11:30, etc.)
Last departure: 9:30pm (10:30pm on Friday & Saturday)

###Convention Center Schedule
Daily ferry service between Coronado Ferry Landing and San Diego Convention Center (5th Avenue). Runs every 30 minutes.

***From Convention Center***

First departure: 9:25am
Departs at :25 and :55 past the hour (9:25, 9:55, 10:25, etc.)
Last departure: 9:55pm (10:55pm on Friday & Saturday)

***From Coronado Island***

First departure: 9:10am
Departs at :10 and :40 past the hour (9:10, 9:40, 10:10, etc.)
Last departure: 9:40pm (10:40pm on Friday & Saturday)
